description.value: Ralph River Campground occupies a forested valley inside Strathcona Provincial Park — BC's oldest park and a 250,000-hectare mountain wilderness — offering a large developed basecamp near Buttle Lake for hiking, fishing, and alpine exploration on a summer operating season.
